title: The outside passed pawn
line: A pawn far from the others pulls the enemy king away.

steps.text: No black pawn stands ahead of the pawn on a4, on its own file or the next: it is passed. Far from the rest, it is an outside passed pawn.
The black king must go after it. While it does, your king walks over to Black's pawns on the other side.
Push the outside pawn, to pull the black king away.

also.e3f3: That also keeps the game in hand. This lesson pushes the outside pawn first.

steps.hint: Move the pawn far from the others.
steps.after: The black king has to chase it.

steps.text: The black king left. Take your king the other way, toward Black's pawns.
steps.after: While the black king goes after the pawn on the edge, your king eats the pawns on the other side.

summary: Push the outside passed pawn to pull the enemy king away, then take your king to the pawns it left.
